newsitem.title: IRAN: Islamic revolution powerful abroad, Iran says.
newsitem.headline: Islamic revolution powerful abroad, Iran says.

text.p: Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani returned on Sunday from a six-nation tour of Africa and said the Islamic revolution was respected around the world.

The official Islamic Republic News Agency (IRNA) said he told reporters the visit demonstrated that despite what he termed U.S. conspiracies, Islam and the Islamic revolution of Iran were respected and cherished throughout the world.
The African people were grateful to Iran for its attention to the problems and issues in their countries, he added.
Rafsanjani visited Kenya, Uganda, Sudan, Tanzania, Zimbabwe and South Africa.
